engine.name: Jomox XBASE 888
engine.description: Jomox XBASE 888 drum machine: every sound, LFO, mute and pan controller of its operating manual's MIDI implementation.

sources.title: XBASE 888 Operating Manual
sources.notes: The MIDI implementation's controller tables (PDF pages 81 - 86), read by tools/profiles/jomox/read-jomox-cc.mjs from XBASE888_E.pdf (sha256 073a017ca650969ba8936592563e48e8c7a470bfe5e0f1d6532ff8187138f623), https://www.jomox.de/upload/manuals/XBASE888_E.pdf, linked from https://www.jomox.de/support.php?lang=2&product_id=10. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/jomox/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/jomox/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI implementation, sent as the controller it prints, on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

A value range named one each by the internal range beside it (`0/64  Off/On`) is a choice; values printed without names are a choice of those values; every other range is a number, its internal range or resolution in its description.
Controllers several rows share, each row sending its own values: CC 62, 63, 93, 75, 79. Read back, such a controller cannot say which row it is.

coverage.editBufferDumpParse: notImplemented: the manual prints a dump's header but not its bytes' meaning
coverage.inboundControllers: the controllers the instrument sends, as the table gives them
